one_liner: SE Ranking offers a broad REST Data/Project API authenticated with a single API key and a vendor-hosted MCP server; access is via a 14-day trial with 100K credits, then paid credits or plans.
auth_notes: REST API uses a static API key generated in the API Dashboard, sent as 'Authorization: Token KEY' (recommended) or an apikey query param. One key works for both Data and Project APIs. No OAuth is documented for the REST API in the provided pages; the earlier OAuth claim (MCP only) could not be verified from the pages and was removed.
access_notes: 14-day trial with 100K credits across all endpoints and MCP, no credit card required. After the trial, a pay-as-you-go wallet (from $50 for 250K credits), API add-on, or standalone plan is needed. No ongoing free tier.
blocker_notes: Self-serve key creation, but ongoing use needs paid credits or a plan after the 14-day trial.
